task.sortit.help: Chomp an item, carry it to the right platform, and drop it with the same button.
task.measureit.help: Use the + and − pads to change the amount, then stomp the big green button.
task.numberpath.help: Step only on the true stones. Wrong stones boing you back — no harm done!
task.quickfire.help: Stomp the platform with the right answer!

fact.place-value.1: In 3,207 the 2 is worth 200 — its place gives it its value!
fact.place-value.2: Zero is a hero: in 507 it holds the tens place so the 5 can mean 500.
fact.addsub.1: Adding in any order gives the same total: 8 + 5 = 5 + 8.
fact.addsub.2: Subtraction undoes addition — they're a team of opposites!
fact.times-tables.1: To multiply by 4, double the number… then double it again!
fact.times-tables.2: Every times table answer for 8 is even. Every single one!
fact.rocks-soils.1: Igneous rock is made from cooled melted rock — volcano leftovers!
fact.rocks-soils.2: Fossils usually form in sedimentary rock, squeezed from layers of mud and sand.
fact.rocks-soils.3: Soil is a mix of tiny rock bits and old plant material.
fact.skeletons.1: Your skeleton does three jobs: support, protection, and movement.
fact.skeletons.2: Muscles work in pairs — one pulls while the other relaxes.
fact.gears-levers.1: A small gear driving a big gear turns fast but pushes with more force.
fact.gears-levers.2: A lever lets a small push lift a heavy load — the longer the arm, the easier it is.
fact.gears-levers.3: Triangles make structures strong — they have no way to lean!
fact.symmetry.1: A shape has line symmetry if one half is a mirror of the other.
fact.roman-numerals.1: In Roman numerals, IV means one-before-five: 4!
fact.roman-numerals.2: X is ten. XII is twelve. A clock face often shows them!
fact.circuits.1: Electricity only flows around a complete loop — one gap and it stops.
fact.circuits.2: Metals conduct electricity; plastic and wood do not.
fact.measurement.1: 1,000 millilitres make 1 litre — a big water bottle!
fact.measurement.2: 100 centimetres make 1 metre — about one big step.
credits.thanks: Made with love, curiosity, and a very loud RAAAAR.
